# Yarn Client Operations

*Navigation: [[index|← StashStats Index]] / [[client-overview|Client Architecture]] / Yarn Client Operations*
*Siblings: [[client-stash|Stash Operations]] · [[client-projects|Project Operations]]*

The `YarnClientMixin` handles queries against the official Ravelry yarn database, including search lookups, fiber categories, and standard weight tables.

## Yarn Catalog Search

`search_yarns` enables keyword searching across commercial and indie yarn lines:

```{.python include="../src/stashstats/client/yarn.py" snippet="yarn-search"}
```

## Reference Data Caching

Yarn queries utilize the local SQLite reference database and Redis cache layer to avoid repeated API requests for static yarn metadata.
